title: Yarn Sort Studio
description: Sort cozy bundles of colorful wool yarn into matching trays of three to weave vibrant pixel-art tapestries stitch by stitch.
controls: Tap yarn slots to pick up and transfer matching wool colors; complete sets of three to weave pixels onto the canvas.

zh-CN.title: 毛线排序填色
zh-CN.description: 超治愈 ASMR 毛线整理填色：把杂乱的彩色毛线按同色凑齐三根归槽，一针一线织出隐藏的像素画作。
zh-CN.controls: 点击底部毛线槽拾取并转移同色毛线，凑满一组自动为上方像素画填色，支持撤回与整理道具。
